prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a golden-hour beauty gifting campaign. Centerpiece is a woman outdoors in warm sunset light holding a shimmering NUXE oil bottle near her shoulder, showing glossy summer skin. Background is a resort-style exterior with wooden beams and open sky. Surrounding elements: a white-orange lower banner reading 'Tặng hộp quà GWP khi mua hàng tại Website/App/Store Lixibox' and an orange coupon strip 'NHẬP MÃ: SUNDATE'. Keep the intimate beauty-lifestyle framing and warm bronzed skin finish. Technical style: high fidelity beauty lifestyle photography, golden-hour outdoor lighting, soft sunset romance and glossy skin highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
